correctness.rationale: For every connected simple n>=2 diameter-at-most-2 graph a k-block distance multiset has exactly one 0 and its remaining k-1 entries in {1,2}; at most k codes force k=n, but repeated degrees force two equal all-singleton codes. At diameter 3 a fully independent labelled graph and set-partition census finds connected counts 12,300,12540 at orders 4,5,6, and resolving counts 0,0,720; all 720 labelled witnesses are one orbit of the six-vertex H with edges 01,03,04,12,15,23,34. Its 203 partitions contain exactly the two resolving five-block partitions joining {1,2} or {1,3}. This checks the finite assertion exhaustively, not an infinite diameter-3 classification.
